content.short: Vulcan Forged is a crypto gaming studio hosting an NFT marketplace, a DEX, and a broad library of games.
content.description: Vulcan Forged is a major player in the crypto gaming space, with cross-chain compatibility and more than 100,000 active users. The ecosystem aims to be a complete crypto gaming studio, launchpad, and marketplace. Its flagship title, Vulcan Verse, is a lore-rich open-world MMORPG. The platform already hosts more than ten play-to-earn games, appealing to gamers from diverse backgrounds and interests. Together, these offerings create a multi-chain ecosystem where players can discover, trade, and grow across multiple worlds.
